text:
lina: noticed spike in cost card — cache savings showing under model only, no route split. saw during morning canary.

omar: can you paste the quick query you used to check?

lina: small one:
```
SELECT route_id, model_sku, SUM(cache_saved_tokens) AS saved
FROM token_events
WHERE ts > now() - interval '4 hours'
GROUP BY route_id, model_sku
ORDER BY saved DESC
LIMIT 20;
```
raw rows show route=\"invite-flow\" saved=120k but dashboard lists model_sku=\"m-2\" 120k, no route.

omar: likely the normalizer flattened billing_context into a single billing_key. we used that to limit cardinality but it hides route_id.

priya: UX/product suggestion: add two columns on the cost card — Observed (raw tokens) and Attributed (allocated by route/model). gate behind feature flag `costs.per_route_attr` so we can roll slowly.

frank: backend plan: emit route_id + model_sku into token_ledger, prefer route when present. server-side top-5 bucketing for routes and "other". add small backfill for last 7 days into attributed_route column.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for ingest-service @ 2025-02-14T08:00:00Z

omar: tests: unit for aggregator splitting same-model events across routes; e2e for UI toggle. also add alert if any tenant sees >20% attribution delta in 1h post-rollout.

lina: opening draft PR with normalizer change, migration notes, and UX mocks: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/2789 (WIP). will enable flag in staging after backfill.

priya: thanks — will review mocks. small copy note: tooltip should say "Attribution is best-effort and may change during rollout".

frank: will add deterministic tie-breaks for top-N and ensure aggregation cost delta metric is emitted.

lina: sweet. ping here when staging flag is on and we have canary metrics. :thumbsup:
